id: cuad:PACIRA PHARMACEUTICALS, INC. - A_R STRATEGIC LICENSING, DISTRIBUTION AND MARKETING AGREEMENT

findings.quoted_text: EKR may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon [**] ([**]) days prior, written notice to PPI.

EKR shall pay to PPI, any Minimum Royalties and Additional Royalties due within forty-five (45) days of the end of each Quarter as the case may be subject to reconciliation at the end of each Calendar Year as set forth in Section 6.9.
EKR may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon [**] ([**]) days prior, written notice to [PARTY_D].
findings.explanation: Only the Client (EKR) is granted the right to terminate the agreement for convenience without cause, leaving you without guaranteed contract duration or full compensation for committed costs.
findings.suggested_change: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days prior written notice to the other Party.

findings.quoted_text: Any and all liability of [PARTY_D] to EKR howsoever arising in respect of this Agreement, the Transition Services and Inventory Agreement or the Supply Agreement and their performance, in contract tort or otherwise, shall be limited (except for death or personal injury caused by the negligence of [PARTY_D] or its employees while acting in the course of their employment) to [**] US Dollars ($[**]); provided however that such limitation shall not apply to the extent that EKR or any EKR Indemnified Party is required to pay in excess of such amount to a third party in respect of a final judgment or order obtained by the third party or as a result of [PARTY_D]'s breach of Section 7.2.12 of the Supply Agreement.
findings.explanation: Third-party claims and indemnification obligations are carved out from your liability cap, exposing you to potentially unlimited financial exposure for those claims.
findings.suggested_change: The aggregate liability of [PARTY_D] under this Agreement shall be strictly capped at the stated amount inclusive of all third-party claims and indemnification obligations.

findings.quoted_text: EKR shall pay to [PARTY_D], any Minimum Royalties and Additional Royalties due within forty-five (45) days of the end of each Quarter as the case may be subject to reconciliation at the end of each Calendar Year as set forth in Section 6.9.
findings.explanation: Payment terms requiring settlement 45 days after the end of the quarter exceed standard 30-day payment terms, delaying your cash flow.
findings.suggested_change: EKR shall pay to [PARTY_D] any Minimum Royalties and Additional Royalties due within thirty (30) days of the end of each Quarter.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. Before signing, I would like to propose a couple of adjustments: - Regarding the relevant clause on termination, the current wording allows only one side to terminate without cause, so I propose that either party may terminate this agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days prior written notice to the other party. - Regarding the relevant clause on payment, the timeline delays cash flow, so I propose that EKR shall pay to [PARTY_D] any Minimum Royalties and Additional Royalties due within thirty (30) days of the end of each Quarter. Thank you and best regards.
